alt: 2023 Honda CR-V EX-L AWD in white photographed from the front-right, the exact model affected by the wiper-arm nozzle design that leaves the A-pillar corner unwiped
story: The 2023–2026 Honda CR-V places windshield-washer nozzles on the wiper arms instead of the hood, so coverage is poor — and owners report the driver-side wiper doesn't sweep the full windshield up to the A-pillar; when taken to dealers, they were told it is 'a feature, not a bug.'
why_funny: Honda engineered four consecutive model years of a rain-clearing system that can't fully clear the rain, and the official position is that this is working as intended.
